description: This Java source file defines a final class 'ClusterStatusStage' that creates an Akka stream stage for monitoring cluster health. It retrieves the current cluster status, checks for unreachable members, and validates the presence of expected roles, emitting either the count of instances or a rejection decision accordingly.

classes.name: ClusterStatusStage
classes.description: A utility class providing an Akka stream graph stage that evaluates cluster health and emits either the number of instances of certain roles or a credit rejection decision based on cluster reachability and role presence.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an Akka stream graph stage triggered by a message, which retrieves the current cluster status, checks whether all members are reachable and expected roles are present, and emits either the total number of role instances or a rejection decision.

methods.name: create (overload)
methods.description: Creates the cluster status stage using a provided ClusterStatusSupplier, encapsulating cluster status retrieval logic.

methods.name: getPersistenceInstances
methods.description: Determines whether the cluster has all members reachable; if so, counts the members of expected roles, otherwise returns a rejection decision.

methods.name: areAllMembersReachable
methods.description: Checks if the cluster has no unreachable members.

methods.name: countMembersOfExpectedRoles
methods.description: Counts the total number of reachable members across the expected roles; if some roles are missing, returns a rejection decision.
